name: Seiya
source:
He works as a host and has a do-S personality.
Rui's twin brother.
He doesn't care what happens around him as long as it's good for him. He has an arrogant and slightly sadistic personality.
He enjoys it when women become entranced with him.
With his personality he's satisfied making his living as a host.
His flower is the Narcissus.
